title: Legible Failures: Detecting and Repairing In-Context Binding Errors
abstract: arXiv:2609.11216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A wrong answer does not show whether the model lacked the needed information or held it and failed to use it. On an entity-obligation binding task, a language model can emit an incorrect prompt-supplied binding while a linear probe can recover the correct one from its frozen hidden state. We measure how often this occurs across 16 public checkpoints, each evaluated with three seeds. We fit a probe on a training fold, select its layer on a validation fold, and report results on a disjoint test fold. On the trials each model gets wrong, probe accuracy exceeds the strict present-obligation baseline, 1/K = 0.125, by +0.196 (95% CI [+0.101, +0.296], bootstrapped over models). A query-entity counterfactual rules out token presence and recency. A score built from the sign of probe-output disagreement improves failure detection over the model's own confidence by +0.079 AUROC (95% CI [+0.036, +0.126]). translated_title: 可解读的失败：检测与修复上下文绑定错误
translated_abstract: 一个错误的答案并不能表明模型是缺乏所需的信息，还是已经持有该信息却未能使用它。在一个实体-义务绑定任务中，语言模型可能会输出一个错误的提示词所提供的绑定关系，而线性探针却可以从其冻结的隐藏状态中恢复出正确的绑定。我们测量了这种情况在16个公开模型检查点（每个检查点用三个随机种子评估）中发生的频率。我们在训练折上拟合探针，在验证折上选择探针层级，并在互不相交的测试折上报告结果。在每个模型答错的试验中，探针准确率超过严格的“存在义务”基线（1/K = 0.125）达+0.196（95%置信区间 [+0.101, +0.296]，跨模型自助法计算）。查询-实体反事实实验排除了词元存在性和近因效应的解释。基于探针输出不一致符号构建的分数，相比模型自身的置信度，将失败检测性能提升了+0.079 AUROC（95%置信区间 [+0.036, +0.126]）。原始探针置信度则没有可测量的……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文发现语言模型在实体-义务绑定任务上答错时，正确答案通常仍隐藏在其内部表征中，可通过线性探针恢复，且基于探针输出分歧的信号能比模型自身置信度更有效地检测此类失败。
en_tdlr: When language models make entity-obligation binding errors, the correct binding is often still recoverable from their hidden states via linear probes, and probe disagreement signals detect these failures better than the model's own confidence.
